description: Use this when the user asks what a formula of theirs will smell like, how it evolves or how long it lasts, by PerfuMate's own scent model, exactly as the app's scent profile sheet shows it: families and sub-notes by weight and by perceived impact, the drydown at 0, 1, 4, 8 and 24 hours, the wear line (projection and longevity, e.g. "Bold · moderate wear") with its confidence, the genre, and the five-part note pyramid. Accords count by what they hold.

formula.description: The formula: its id (from list_formulas) or its exact name.

name: get_scent_profile
title: Scent profile of a formula
